subtitle: Lesson 7 · Relationships & the Dependency View

code:
If this CI goes down, what else is affected?

  Start at the failed CI
  Walk its relationships outward
  Read off everything that depends on it
caption: A graph walk, not a guess — and only as good as the data underneath it.

code:
One hop only (incomplete):
  Database Server --used by--> App Server   [stops here]

Transitive impact (the real chain):
  Database Server --used by--> App Server
                    --runs--> Order Application
                    --supports--> Online Ordering (business service)
caption: The real impact is usually several hops from the failed CI.

steps.label: App server depends on the database
Order Processing supports Online Ordering
steps.sub: the business service that actually matters

eyebrow: Why this matters two courses from now
code:
Change Risk Assessment:  "does this touch a business-critical CI?"
CAB Conflict Detection:  "does this affect the same CI as another change?"

Both questions are impact-analysis graph walks underneath.
Bad relationships => confidently wrong risk and missed conflicts.
caption: Those later features are only as trustworthy as this chapter's data.
